messages:
ashley: FYI payments flagged a chargeback on invoice_netting account acct_77412 for $3,200. Cardholder says duplicate/unauthorized charge. Need evidence + quick recommendation.
billing-bot: Chargeback created  CB99223344 for txn `T20260429-cd9`  reason: duplicate; dispute window closes 2026-06-28.
ryan: quick summary: invoice netting process ran on 2026-04-28 23:58Z. Two invoices (inv_7782, inv_7783) were auto-netted and a single refund issued to card **** **** **** 7777 for $3,200. Customer claims they only had one original payment.
marta: system logs show netting job used file from vendor AcmeClearing SFTP: /outgoing/netting/2026-04-28/batch-99.csv. File contained duplicate charge lines for acct_77412.
ash: (ops-oncall) Checked SFTP: file owner is partner_acme (scp key fingerprint: 80:ab...). Last modify 2026-04-28T23:55Z. Our ingest accepted both lines; dedupe didn't trigger because external_reference IDs differed (ref_a and ref_a-dup).
ash: Also found webhook callback to refunds API with payload: `{"charge":"T20260428-55","amount":3200,"reason":"invoice_netting"}` recorded at 2026-04-28T23:59:02Z. Response 200.
ryan: Customer KYC: acct_77412 is small biz "Northbridge LLC" in CA, billing@northbridge.example.org. Last console access 2026-04-27. No suspicious logins.
marta: Partner note: AcmeClearing emailed earlier on 2026-04-28 that they had a delayed batch re-send due to upstream duplication. They said they "fixed" it post-run but didn't provide signed audit log yet.
ash: Evidence collected: SFTP batch file, ingest logs, refund API request/response, webhook delivery, account KYC snapshot, partner email. Uploaded to disputes: https://redwood.internal/evidence/CB99223344.
ash: Ops recommends revoking partner SFTP key pending audit and enable stricter dedupe for invoice_netting flows.
ashley: Recommendation: place provisional hold on acct_77412 (HLD-20260429-05), notify CS to pause outreach, and ask AcmeClearing for signed audit trail + reproduction steps. Legal: can we contest duplicate claim if partner admits duplicate data?
ryan: Legal likely wants partner logs to show intent/neglect. If partner admits error, we can dispute and present proof buyer got two refunds. If customer claims unauthorized, Legal may still advise settlement.
ash: Hold placed HLD-20260429-05 at 2026-04-29T01:02Z. Notifying AcmeClearing security contact and filing SEC ticket SEC-20260429-11 to request SFTP transfer logs, prior rotations, and checksums.
marta: I'll draft the merchant response with timestamps, batch file, and refund evidence. Will add to the packet in the morning.
ash: tagging billing-bot to ensure case reminder at +7 days for partner logs.
billing-bot: Reminder set for CB99223344 in 7 days.
ash: Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread.
